shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app -type f | head -50 && echo --- && cat /workspace/app/layout.* 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/next.config.ts

(npx next start -p 3123 &>/tmp/next.log &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- no cookie ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123 -H "Accept-Language: fr-FR,fr;q=0.9" | grep -o '<section>.*</section>' && echo "--- with theme=dark ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123 -b "theme=dark" -H "Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9" | grep -o '<section>.*</section>'; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
